name: Your Name
headline: Student researcher and builder turning ideas into work the world can use.
about: This is a sample profile. It shows exactly how a researcher page looks, so you can see the layout before anyone writes their own. Every box here is filled with example text that you replace with your own story.

A real researcher would use these paragraphs to explain what they are working on, why it matters to them, and what they hope to build next. Short and specific beats long and vague, so aim for two or three clear paragraphs.
Once you have your own copy, open research/data/researchers.json, find the entry with your slug, and start editing. Nothing on this site needs a build step for that, just run the build script again.

works.title: Sample project title
works.summary: One clear sentence about what you built and the problem it solves.
works.result: Add your best result, such as how many people used it or how well it worked.
works.detail: Add the full story here. What did you build, how does it work, what were the results, and what proof do you have? Demo videos, photos and test results all belong on this page.

works.title: Sample research paper title
works.summary: One clear sentence about your research question and what you found.
works.result: Add your main finding in one line, with a number if you have one.
works.detail: Add your method, your main findings, and what you would study next. Link the full paper and any supporting files so anyone can check your work.

works.title: Another project, with research
works.summary: A project backed by a study, shown together so people can see both.
works.result: Add what the study showed about how well the project works.
works.detail: Projects with supporting research are the strongest. Show the build and the evidence side by side.

impact.d: Describe the real result in one line, with a number if you have one. For example, how many people tested it.
Say what proof you shared with the EAGLOPEN review team, such as a demo, test results or a paper.
